targetText: that it was opportunism that led to the collapse of the Second International, which openly called for the building of a Marxist International without and against the opportunists.
summary: Lenin argues that the restoration of an international socialist movement cannot happen through compromise with social-chauvinists, but requires a clean organizational split and the creation of a Third International.
context: The Second International effectively collapsed in 1914 when its member sections turned against each other in support of rival imperialist war efforts, leading Lenin to advocate the founding of the Communist International.
